nc14e01.title: The first cold night
nc14e01.caption: One cold night and suddenly all twelve signs are taking blanket applications. The stars have a better question than who's free all winter. Who in your group chat started cuffing first?

nc14e02.title: Aries asks in October energy
nc14e02.caption: Aries skipped hello and went straight to a sign that says WINTER WITH ME?, in a T-shirt, in the snow. Same fire, a little slower. Ever been asked out at full speed?

nc14e03.title: Taurus builds the blanket fort first
nc14e03.caption: Taurus built a five-star fort with a snack shelf and forgot to invite anyone into it. One text fixed that. Who would you send the fort invite to?

nc14e04.title: Gemini's three almost-dates
nc14e04.caption: Three maybes, one Friday, one very dizzy Gemini. Two kind no's and a real yes later, Friday got a lot calmer. Tag the friend who says maybe to everything.

nc14e05.title: Cancer has the soup ready
nc14e05.caption: Cancer made a whole pot of soup for someone it hadn't asked yet, then hid behind the counter when they walked by. Brave move at the door, though. What's your comfort meal?

nc14e06.title: Leo wants a winter photo partner
nc14e06.caption: Leo auditioned a snowman, a lamp post and a passing Sagittarius, and somehow every print was still just Leo. Then it turned the camera around. Who takes the best photos of you?

nc14e07.title: Virgo's cuffing spreadsheet
nc14e07.caption: Virgo's spreadsheet found a perfect 4/4 match and Virgo felt nothing. Then a Sagittarius tripped in with cocoa and the heart monitor went wild. Which column would you add?

nc14e08.title: Libra can't pick between two scarves
nc14e08.caption: Libra spent half an hour on two scarves, then polled the group chat about two people and got a tie. Turns out it kept reaching for the same one all along. Are you a group-chat poller?

nc14e09.title: Scorpio, all in or nothing
nc14e09.caption: Gemini said cocoa. Scorpio heard matching mittens, a shared calendar and a cabin. Deep is a gift, and it can still start with one sip. Who in your life goes all in?

nc14e10.title: Sag says "I'm not looking"
nc14e10.caption: Sagittarius is a free spirit on a solo trip with no ties, and somehow packed two mugs and two scarves. For balance. Which sign do you know is looking while saying they're not?

nc14e11.title: Capricorn schedules a feelings meeting
nc14e11.caption: Capricorn sent a calendar invite titled FEELINGS with an agenda attached, then froze on the blank slide. The unscripted part went better. Would you accept this meeting?

nc14e12.title: Aquarius invents a heated bench
nc14e12.caption: Aquarius built a heated bench to solve winter for everyone, when it mostly wanted one person to sit down. And then the first snow showed up. What would you invent to avoid saying it out loud?
